Hi, working on TEXTKIT-103 (to_snake_case) which depends on your split_identifier. The design note says leading underscores must be preserved exactly: "_cachedValue" -> "_cached_value", "__InitHook" -> "__init_hook", but trailing underscores dropped ("trailing_" -> "trailing"). When I call split_identifier("_cachedValue"), what does it return? Does it return ["", "cached", "value"] (preserving leading empty parts) or ["cached", "value"] (dropping them)? I need to know to implement the leading-underscore preservation correctly. Thanks!
